data.name: Japanese Bobtail
data.temperament: Active, Agile, Clever, Easy Going, Intelligent, Lively, Loyal, Playful, Social
data.description: The Japanese Bobtail is an active, sweet, loving and highly intelligent breed. They love to be with people and play seemingly endlessly. They learn their name and respond to it. They bring toys to people and play fetch with a favorite toy for hours. Bobtails are social and are at their best when in the company of people. They take over the house and are not intimidated. If a dog is in the house, Bobtails assume Bobtails are in charge.

data.name: Kurilian
data.temperament: Independent, highly intelligent, clever, inquisitive, sociable, playful, trainable
data.description: The character of the Kurilian Bobtail is independent, highly intelligent, clever, inquisitive, sociable, playful, trainable, absent of aggression and very gentle. They are devoted to their humans and when allowed are either on the lap of or sleeping in bed with their owners.

data.name: Siamese
data.temperament: Active, Agile, Clever, Sociable, Loving, Energetic
data.description: While Siamese cats are extremely fond of their people, they will follow you around and supervise your every move, being talkative and opinionated. They are a demanding and social cat, that do not like being left alone for long periods.

data.name: Turkish Angora
data.temperament: Affectionate, Agile, Clever, Gentle, Intelligent, Playful, Social
data.description: This is a smart and intelligent cat which bonds well with humans. With its affectionate and playful personality the Angora is a top choice for families. The Angora gets along great with other pets in the home, but it will make clear who is in charge, and who the house belongs to
